metadata.title: Wizard of Oz — corrected plot spine (current-schema worked example)
discipline-applied: Four-category edge typology (edge-categories.md, 2026-05-11): every edge carries i2t:edge_category.

No reflexive reification: an event is reified ONLY if another edge references it as a node. The 6 plot-spine events earn reification via the history-DAG precedes-edges; wizard_appearance_each does NOT (nothing references it) and is therefore edge-only.
Token-level history-DAG: 6 state_change events sequenced by pairwise precedes-edges into a chain (a DAG / total order over story-time).
Category audit found 6 of 7 events are state_change (plot transitions) and 1 (wizard_appearance_each) is interactivity (a deception channel, one-to-many), so it is NOT on the spine.
metadata.type-quotient-finding: The plot-spine history-DAG is a CHAIN (linear total order); no two spine events share a type, so its type-quotient is trivial (no cycle). A nontrivial type-quotient cycle would require recurring event-types — present in Oz only at the episodic obstacle-encounter level (Kalidahs, fighting trees, hammerheads), not on the main spine. Oz is therefore the near-degenerate case: it demonstrates the token-DAG cleanly and motivates a second fixture WITH recurrence to demonstrate the cyclic type-quotient.

attrs.label: Aunt Em
attrs.role: Dorothy's aunt; once young and pretty, made gray by the prairie sun and wind

attrs.label: the Bucket of Water
attrs.role: Dorothy throws it on the Wicked Witch of the West; melts her; Dorothy did not know water would have this effect

attrs.label: the Cowardly Lion
attrs.role: great beast who admits his cowardice; wants courage; later King of the Beasts in the south forest

attrs.label: illusion / deception
attrs.role: the Wizard's mode; the Emerald City's green is glasses; the Wizard's terrible forms are pulled-string illusions; the unmasking is the central pivot

attrs.label: Dorothy Gale
attrs.role: protagonist; Kansas orphan; carried to Oz by cyclone; wants to go home

attrs.label: Glinda the Good
attrs.role: Good Witch of the South / Quadling Country; tells Dorothy the Silver Shoes can carry her home

attrs.label: the Golden Cap
attrs.power: holder may command the Winged Monkeys three times before the cap loses its power for that holder
attrs.history: belonged to the Wicked Witch of the West; passed to Dorothy when the witch melted; she uses all three commands

attrs.label: the Good Witch of the North
attrs.role: greets Dorothy in the Munchkin Country; kisses her forehead as protection; tells her to seek the Wizard

attrs.label: home
attrs.role: Dorothy's want; the through-line; the silver shoes were the means all along

attrs.label: Kansas
attrs.role: Dorothy's home; the gray prairie; everywhere is gray under the sun; the place she yearns to return to

attrs.label: Munchkin Country (East)
attrs.role: where Dorothy lands; where the Wicked Witch of the East ruled until the house killed her

attrs.label: the Munchkins
attrs.role: small people of the East; freed by the death of the Wicked Witch of the East; dressed in blue

attrs.label: the Scarecrow
attrs.role: Dorothy's first companion; wants brains; later King of Emerald City; thinks well despite having no brain

attrs.label: the Silver Shoes
attrs.power: carry the wearer anywhere in three steps
attrs.history: belonged to the Wicked Witch of the East; transferred to Dorothy when the witch died; lost in the Deadly Desert when Dorothy returns to Kansas

attrs.label: the Tin Woodman
attrs.role: rusted-shut woodman; was a Munchkin in love with a girl; Witch enchanted his axe to chop off his limbs which were replaced with tin; wants a heart

attrs.label: Toto
attrs.role: Dorothy's companion; non-speaking; the one who pulls aside the Wizard's screen

attrs.label: Uncle Henry
attrs.role: Dorothy's uncle; Kansas farmer; gray, stern, rarely speaks

attrs.label: the Wicked Witch of the East
attrs.role: ruler-tyrant of the Munchkin Country; killed by Dorothy's house when it fell from the cyclone; owned the Silver Shoes

attrs.label: the Wicked Witch of the West
attrs.role: ruler-tyrant of the Winkie Country; one powerful eye like a telescope; afraid of water and the dark; melted by Dorothy

attrs.label: the Winkies
attrs.role: yellow-dressed people of the West; enslaved by the Wicked Witch of the West; freed when she melts; ask the Tin Woodman to be their ruler

attrs.label: the Wicked Witch's Castle
attrs.role: where Dorothy is held captive and made to scrub floors; where the witch melts

attrs.label: the Wizard of Oz
attrs.true_identity: a humbug; a man from Omaha who arrived by balloon; ventriloquist and circus showman
attrs.role: ruler of Emerald City through illusion

attrs.label: the Wizard's hot-air balloon
attrs.role: the way the Wizard came to Oz from Omaha; the way he leaves Emerald City without Dorothy when the rope breaks

attrs.label: the Throne-Room Screen
attrs.role: the screen behind which the Wizard hides; pulls strings to animate his various illusory forms; Toto reveals the man behind it

attrs.label: the Cyclone
attrs.role: transports Dorothy from Kansas to Oz; the originating event of the entire story
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: the Killing of the Wicked Witch of the East
attrs.role: the house falls on her when the cyclone deposits Dorothy; Dorothy did not intend it; frees the Munchkins; Silver Shoes pass to Dorothy
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: the Melting of the Wicked Witch of the West
attrs.role: Dorothy throws a bucket of water on the witch in anger; the witch melts; Dorothy did not know water would do this; Winkies are freed
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: the Unmasking of the Wizard
attrs.role: Toto upsets the screen; the four discover the Wizard is a humbug from Omaha; the Wizard then improvises gifts that work because the recipients believe in them
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: the Balloon's Premature Departure
attrs.role: the Wizard prepares to take Dorothy home in the balloon; Toto chases a kitten; Dorothy follows; the rope breaks; the Wizard ascends without her
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: Dorothy's Return to Kansas
attrs.role: Glinda tells Dorothy the Silver Shoes can carry her home; Dorothy clicks her heels three times and asks; she lands on the Kansas prairie; Aunt Em runs to her
attrs.i2t:reification_justified_by: history-DAG precedes-edges reference this event as a node

attrs.label: the house whirled around two or three times and rose slowly through the air. Dorothy felt as if she were going up in a balloon. ... it was carried miles and miles away as easily as you could carry a feather.
the house, as I said before, fell with a thud upon the Wicked Witch of the East, and as she had been wicked many years she dried up in the sun, leaving only the silver shoes behind.
in a few minutes I shall melt away. ... she fell down in a brown, melted, shapeless mass and began to spread over the clean boards of the kitchen floor.

Toto had jumped from Dorothy's arms and hidden behind the screen. As Toto ran he tipped over the screen that stood in a corner. As it fell with a crash they looked that way, and the next moment all of them were filled with wonder.

Dorothy had run after Toto, when she saw the great balloon shoot into the air, without her in it. Come back! Come back! she screamed; I want to go, too! I can't come back, my dear, called Oz from the balloon. Good-bye!
the Silver Shoes will carry you in three steps... All you have to do is to knock the heels together three times and command the shoes to carry you wherever you wish to go.
Oz could take on any form he wished. So one day he would be like a fairy, and the next like a ferocious beast, and the third like a great fire... but he never lets anyone see his real shape.

attrs.state: in the bed when the house lands

attrs.manner: crushed when the cyclone-borne house lands on her

attrs.awareness: she did not know there was a witch beneath

attrs.vulnerability: water; afraid of the dark; never bathed in her life

attrs.reaction: shouted for joy and held a great holiday

attrs.true_form: a little old man, with a bald head and a wrinkled face

attrs.destination: Omaha (presumed); the rope breaks; he ascends and is never seen again

attrs.cause: ran after Toto, who had chased a kitten

attrs.fate: fall off during flight and are lost in the Deadly Desert forever

attrs.action: tells Dorothy how to use the shoes
ran to her, caught her in her arms, and covered her face with kisses
